snippets: We also require creators to label all AI-generated content that contains realistic images, audio, and video, as explained in our Community Guidelines.
Creators can disclose content as AI-generated directly on the post by adding text, a hashtag sticker, or context in the post's description.
Misleadingly labeling unaltered content with this label is a violation of our Terms of Service and may result in the removal of content.
TikTok may automatically apply the "AI-generated" label to content we identify as completely generated or significantly edited with AI.
Once your content is labeled as AI-generated with an auto label, you won't be able to remove the label from your post.
We do not allow AI-generated content that shows fake authoritative sources or crisis events, or falsely shows public figures in certain contexts.
We do not allow AI-generated content that shows the likeness of young people under the age of 18, or the likeness of adult private figures used without their permission.
Turning on the AI-generated content setting won't affect the distribution of your video as long as it doesn't violate our Community Guidelines.
We may remove content that violates our Community Guidelines policies by depicting misleading information or unlabeled AI-generated content.
